action.description: create → title, assignedTo; get, patch, archive, complete → id; delegate → id, assignedTo.

description.description: Task details. For create and patch.

dueAt.description: When the task is due, ISO 8601. For create.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a resend returns the first result.

lessonsLearned.description: What to remember from it. For patch and complete.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON. For create and patch.

outcome.description: What came of the task. For patch and complete.

parentTaskId.description: Parent task id, making this a subtask. For create.

parentTaskIdFilter.description: For list: only the subtasks of this task.

priority.description: critical, high, medium or low. For create and patch.

sensitivity.description: Set on create only (patch refuses it). Default 'internal'.

sessionId.description: The session the task belongs to. For create.

status.description: For patch: new status. For list: a filter.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context). action='create' only.
